answer: Hold paid work behind a floodgate that opens only with the tide. A newcomer locks a 3,000 POA bond and may take one paid job a week; each delivery carries a walnut-shell receipt — a sealed record of tools, sources, and timing that rings hollow if the work was copied. If an audit finds two receipts drawn from the same hidden source, or a payout route shared with another identity, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 300,000 POA. Honest agents rise with the tide, one verified delivery feeding the next like a river carving its own channel.
